title: Beauty Brand Manager
description:
Are you ready to take your career to the next level with a premium beauty brand portfolio? This is a rare opportunity to join a fast-paced, high-growth luxury beauty business where creativity, innovation, and commercial impact come together.

We are looking for a dynamic Brand Manager to shape and elevate brand presence across key retail channels, delivering best-in-class campaigns that inspire customers and drive performance.

Client Details

Our client is a leading player in the luxury beauty space, partnering with some of the world's most exciting premium brands to bring them to life in the UK market.

Working at the heart of the industry, they combine distribution expertise with creative marketing and retail execution, ensuring their brands stand out across top-tier retail environments.

Fast-paced, entrepreneurial and brand-led, this is a business where innovation, relationships and commercial impact truly matter.

Description

In this role, you will bring brands to life within the retail environment and ensure a seamless customer journey across all touchpoints.

You will:
- Lead the development and execution of innovative trade and shopper marketing strategies
- Create impactful campaigns and activations that reflect the luxury positioning of the brand
- Analyse market trends, consumer behaviour and competitor activity to unlock growth opportunities
- Partner cross-functionally with sales, brand and external agencies to ensure flawless execution
- Manage budgets effectively, delivering strong ROI
- Monitor and optimise performance through key KPIs

Profile

We are seeking a commercially driven, creative marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

You will bring:
- Experience within beauty/FMCG, ideally with exposure to luxury brands
- Strong trade or shopper marketing expertise
- A deep understanding of consumer behaviour and retail dynamics
- Exceptional project and stakeholder management skills
- A proactive, solutions-focused mindset with a passion for excellence

Job Offer

What's in it for you?
- Competitive salary & benefits package
- Flexible working with a collaborative, supportive culture
- 3-4 days per week in a stunning Surrey office with a premium, inspiring working environment
- The opportunity to work with a leading luxury beauty portfolio
- High-impact role with real ownership and visibility across the business

This is a brilliant opportunity for a Brand Manager to combine career progression with a genuinely enjoyable place to work.

title: Content Assistant
company: Michael Page Business Support - Agency - Permanent
description:
As a Content Assistant in Guildford, you will help create, organise and publish content that supports marketing activity across the Media & Agency sector. You will keep content accurate and well presented, helping campaigns and day-to-day communications run smoothly.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Media & Agency industry in Guildford.

Description
- Create and format content for marketing campaigns, digital channels and communications.
- Organise content files and maintain clear records so materials are easy to find and use.
- Proofread copy and check content for accuracy, consistency and clear presentation.
- Prepare content for publication across relevant marketing channels.
- Work with marketing colleagues to gather information and turn it into useful content.
- Update existing content to keep messaging current and aligned with campaign needs.
- Track content deadlines and help ensure materials are ready when required.

Profile

A successful Content Assistant should have:
- Experience creating, editing or organising written and digital content.
- A clear writing style and strong attention to detail when proofreading copy.
- The ability to manage several content tasks and keep work on schedule.
- Confidence working with marketing materials and digital content channels.
- Good organisation skills for maintaining content files and records.
- The ability to work closely with colleagues to gather and present information clearly.

Job Offer
- Permanent Content Assistant role based in Guildford.
- Salary of £28,000 to £32,000 dependent on the level of experience.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

description:
As a Content Producer in Guildford, you will create and manage marketing content that helps a Media & Agency business communicate clearly with its audiences. You will organise content from brief to delivery, keeping work accurate, on brand and ready for use across campaigns.

title: Head of E-Commerce
description:
We're looking for a commercially driven Head of E-Commerce to lead and accelerate online growth across a portfolio of premium beauty brands. This is a high-impact leadership role for an experienced digital commerce professional who can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to deliver outstanding commercial results.

Client Details

Our client is a leading beauty business with a portfolio of premium and luxury brands. With an established presence across multiple markets and ambitious plans for growth, the business continues to invest heavily in its digital capabilities, creating an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded Head of E-Commerce to shape strategy, drive performance and lead the next stage of online growth.

Description

Reporting into the Marketing Director, you'll own the E-commerce strategy and performance across the business's digital channels. Working closely with sales, marketing and leadership teams, you'll be responsible for driving revenue growth, enhancing the customer journey and delivering a best-in-class online experience.

Key responsibilities include:
- Developing and executing the overall e-commerce strategy
- Driving online sales growth, profitability and customer acquisition
- Leading the performance of the brand's e-commerce platforms and key online retail partners
- Optimising website conversion, digital merchandising and customer experience
- Managing promotional plans, digital trading calendars and online campaigns
- Using data and insights to identify growth opportunities and improve performance
- Establishing clear KPIs and reporting frameworks
- Leading and developing the e-commerce team
- Collaborating cross-functionally with marketing, sales and finance teams

Profile

We're looking for a commercially minded E-Commerce leader with experience driving online growth within a premium branded environment.

You'll likely have:
- Significant e-commerce experience and a proven track record of delivering online sales growth
- Experience managing e-commerce platforms and online retail partnerships within the luxury beauty landscape
- Strong digital trading and commercial expertise
- A data-driven approach with excellent analytical skills
- Strong stakeholder management and influencing abilities
- An entrepreneurial mindset and hands-on approach

Job Offer
- Opportunity to lead the E-commerce strategy for a prestigious luxury brand business
- High-profile role with significant influence across the business
- Hybrid working with 3-4 days per week in Surrey office location
- Competitive salary and benefits package
- Collaborative and entrepreneurial culture
- Genuine opportunity to shape and grow a key business function

Interested in finding out more? We'd love to hear from you.

title: Home Based Marketing and Sales
description:
We are looking for independent self-motivated people to work from home on a part-time or full-time basis. The role is to develop a small number of regular re-ordering customers. The duties are a mixture of marketing, sales and customer service with the focus on customer retention. There is no requirement for cold calling.

This is an independent income opportunity, not a job or employment. The initial income is based on client orders, but after a month or two provides a consistent income from regular re-orders. It would be ideal to start part-time, but can be developed to provide a full-time income. The bigger and longer term income is a commission on team members. It is a very International business, so you are by no means limited to the UK. Please note that it is totally free to start this opportunity.

Along with marketing or sales experience, you will need to have excellent communication skills - capable of talking to people at all levels. This role would suit somebody who enjoys meeting people, who can work without supervision and is keen to succeed.

Skills / Experience
Interested in helping others improve lifestyle
Good at building relationships
Good at networking with other people
Good Social Media Facebook, Instagram and Twitter)
Able to work without supervision
Self-motivated
Independent
Ambitious
Keen to learn

To a large extent your background isn't important, although experience in the Internet and Social Media (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram) would be an advantage. The main thing is to have the motivation to work without supervision, to have a positive attitude, to be willing to learn and the drive to become successful.

We will provide extensive initial training and ongoing training and support.

title: Marketing Assistant
company: HAWK BROWN RECRUITMENT LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Marketing Assistant

Addlestone

£25k - £28 K per annum

We are seeking a confident, organised and enthusiastic Marketing Assistant to join a busy and collaborative Marketing team in Addlestone.

Working closely with experienced senior colleagues, you will support a broad range of marketing, business development and communications activities across the Group. This is an exciting opportunity to get involved in a variety of projects, including digital marketing, CRM, content creation, events and reporting, while contributing fresh ideas and developing your skills. You will:
- Support the Marketing team with the delivery of marketing, business development and communications initiatives across the Group
- Assist with maintaining and updating website content, including uploading articles and making routine changes using WordPress
- Help organise and coordinate client events, seminars and webinars, managing invitations, logistics, event delivery and follow-up activities
- Support internal Group meetings and events, including two or three larger off-site meetings each year, which may involve overseas travel
- Assist with email marketing campaigns and newsletters using HubSpot
- Draft, edit and coordinate marketing materials, including newsletters, invitations, seminar materials, client updates and internal communications
- Contribute to the development and production of the company's internal magazine and other publications
- Create engaging marketing collateral, including written content and designs using Canva
- Assist with document production using Adobe InDesign and similar design software, with training available
- Support social media activities, including scheduling and publishing content and providing guidance to colleagues on different platforms
- Prepare and maintain marketing reports, analysing information from various sources to help monitor performance
- Liaise with colleagues across different offices, gaining an understanding of local markets, business activities and client requirements
- Participate in regular online meetings with senior members of the Marketing team
- Coordinate multiple projects, schedules and approval processes, ensuring tasks are completed accurately and within agreed deadlines
- Provide support across both ongoing and ad hoc marketing projects as required
- Work closely with colleagues, external suppliers and stakeholders, bringing a positive, proactive and collaborative approach

The ideal candidate will:
- Ideally have a minimum of 1 years' experience within Digital Marketing
- Have a university degree or relevant marketing qualification
- Be confident, friendly and approachable, with excellent interpersonal skills
- Have strong written and verbal communication skills
- Be highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities
- Be able to work efficiently, remain calm under pressure and consistently meet deadlines
- Be a proactive team player
- Have good problem-solving, prioritisation and time-management skills
- Be flexible and adaptable, with the ability to respond to changing business needs
- Be comfortable communicating with colleagues at all levels, as well as clients, suppliers and external contacts
- Be confident contributing to meetings, presentations and training sessions
- Have good analytical skills and the ability to work with information from different sources
- Have good working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams
- Ideally have experience using HubSpot and WordPress
- Ideally have familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly InDesign, and Canva

Working hours are Monday to Friday 9am to 5.30p. Hybrid working following probation.

Benefits include excellent training, progression, parking on site, healthcare insurance, 22 days holiday which rises to 25 days & pension.

title: Marketing Lead ( Sales & Events )
description:
Marketing Lead ( Sales & Events )

Impact Food Group

At Impact Food Group, we re more than just a school caterer. We re on a mission to create a positive food culture and help more students enjoy healthier, better-quality food. Making a positive social impact is at the heart of everything we do. We re constantly learning, evolving, and improving every way, every day.

Through our industry-leading brands Innovate, Dolce, Hutchison, Cucina, and Chapter One we cater for over 800,000 students and operate in more than 1500 schools nationwide, growing every year.

We re now looking for a talented and highly organised B2 B Lead Generation Manager to join and play a vital role in supporting our business.

Guided by our values, integrity, bold, impactful, humble and community; you will help us shape a workplace and culture we can all be proud of.

Impact Food Group is looking for a highly engaging and motivated Sales Lead Generation Manager to build and manage a high-performing lead generation programme that supports our Direct Sales growth.

The role will create a consistent pipeline of qualified school leads for our Sales teams across two business propositions

This is a hands-on role for someone who already understands Event, Digital and Marketing lead generation and can bring expertise, ideas and best practice into the business.

Role Responsibilities:

Events
- Manage end to end our Events / Conference, approx. 1-2 a month, alongside our sales team to create leads for our Sales team.
- Identify the conferences, exhibitions, networking opportunities and events most likely to generate valuable leads.
- Develop pre-event meeting campaigns, lead capture and structured post-event follow-up.

Direct Mail
- Develop targeted email, digital and brochure/direct-mail campaigns.
- Build nurture campaigns for prospects who are not yet ready to engage with Sales.
- Consider innovative brand awareness activity to ensure good news are effectively broadcast to prospective clients.

Lead Generation plan
- Develop and own the lead generation strategy and annual activity plan.
- Identify target audiences, priority segments and prospect opportunities across schools, Trusts and the wider education sector.
- Work closely with Sales to understand priority opportunities and identify what constitutes a qualified lead, establishing an effective process for lead handover.

Telesales & Outbound
- Research, recommend and implement effective telesales and outbound lead generation solutions.
- Identify and manage external telesales partners or recommend appropriate internal solutions.
- Develop targeting data, call strategies, messaging and follow-up journeys.

Digital Lead Generation
- Manage or oversee PPC campaigns, Google Search and other B2 B channels.
- Recommend website SEO improvements for relevant catering and school-support search terms.
- Develop landing pages, calls to action and lead-capture journeys.
- Monitor website traffic and conversion to improve digital performance.
- Agree role for LinkedIn in building awareness and tools such as Sales Navigator.

Content Creation
- Create compelling content that demonstrates IFG's expertise and gives prospective clients a reason to engage, including:
- Sales brochures, Email campaigns, Regional Case studies, LinkedIn content, Presentations, Landing pages, Infographics, Client testimonials, Short-form video
- The role holder will be comfortable creating and adapting content themselves using Adobe Creative Suite and Canva, and able to capture and edit video content for websites, social media, presentations and Sales communications.

What we are looking for
- Events and lead generation experience.
- Experience creating and delivering multi-channel lead generation strategies.
- Evidence of generating qualified leads and measurable Sales pipeline.
- PPC and digital acquisition experience.
- Good practical understanding of SEO and website conversion.
- Experience of outbound marketing, telesales or managing lead-generation partners.
- CRM, marketing automation and Sales funnel reporting experience.
- Experience of email, direct-mail and nurture campaigns.
- Strong understanding of LinkedIn as a B2 B prospecting channel.
- Competence in Adobe Creative Suite and Canva.
- Ability to capture and edit short-form video.
- Strong analytical and performance-management skills.
- Experience within education, contract catering, facilities management, SaaS, professional services or another long-cycle B2 B environment would be advantageous.

What we can offer

Monday to Friday working

25 days holiday plus bank holidays

Access to IFG rewards (money off high street)

Yearly Summer Party

Centrally based offices.

What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV.

title: Product Marketing Executive
description:
Product Marketing Executive

Hybrid / Remote (2-3 office days/2-3 home based Software Organisation

£40,000 - £50,000 + Benefits

Are you a creative and data-driven B2 B marketer looking to take ownership of product marketing initiatives in a global software business?

We are seeking a Product Marketing Executive to help drive awareness, lead generation, customer engagement and product adoption across a growing portfolio of software solutions. Working closely with Product Management, Sales and Marketing teams, you will play a key role in delivering go-to-market programmes, creating compelling messaging, managing campaigns and leveraging AI-powered marketing tools to improve performance and business outcomes.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious marketing professional who enjoys combining strategic thinking with hands-on campaign execution in a fast-paced software environment.

As Product Marketing Executive, you will:
- Execute product marketing campaigns aligned to product roadmaps and commercial objectives
- Support go-to-market initiatives for new product launches and enhancements
- Develop product messaging, positioning and value propositions
- Create sales enablement content, presentations, customer-facing materials and marketing collateral
- Drive demand generation activities and support lead nurturing programmes
- Monitor campaign performance, ROI, conversion rates and pipeline contribution
- Analyse marketing data and provide recommendations for continuous improvement
- Track market trends, customer needs and competitive activity
- Manage digital marketing assets and ensure content remains accurate and compliant
- Collaborate with Product, Sales and Marketing teams across international markets

AI-Enabled Marketing

A key aspect of this role is the practical application of AI within modern marketing operations. You will:
- Utilise AI tools to support content creation, audience targeting, campaign execution and optimisation
- Apply AI-driven approaches to lead scoring, segmentation and marketing efficiency
- Develop repeatable AI-assisted workflows to improve productivity and consistency
- Ensure AI-generated content aligns with brand standards, data privacy and compliance requirements
- Help promote AI best practices throughout the marketing organisation

You'll ideally have:
- 1-2 years' experience in B2 B software Product Marketing
- Practical experience with AI-driven marketing platforms and workflows or experience of using AI for market and competitve analysis, collateral support and lead gen
- Healthtech/healthcare sector experience
- Experience with one of HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce or Dynamics
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
- Excellent organisational and project management capabilities

title: Social Media and Marketing Executive
description:
About April Quest

April Quest specialises in permanent, contract and executive recruitment across engineering, science and technology. We connect talented people with ambitious businesses and take pride in the relationships we build with our clients, candidates and colleagues.

We re looking for a creative, proactive Social Media and Marketing Executive to help raise our profile, showcase our expertise and bring our company culture to life.

This opportunity would suit a marketing graduate or someone early in their career who enjoys creating content, has plenty of ideas and wants to see their work make a direct impact.

The Role

Working closely with our Managing Director, you ll help develop and deliver a practical social media and marketing strategy that supports attracting new clients and candidates who need specialist recruitment support and talented people to join the April Quest team.

LinkedIn will be your primary focus across all three audiences. You ll also develop our presence on Instagram and Facebook, particularly to showcase life at April Quest and support recruitment into our own business.

We want someone who spots opportunities, suggests fresh ideas and follows them through. You ll have support and direction from the Managing Director, alongside the opportunity to take ownership of day-to-day activity.

Key Responsibilities
- Work with the Managing Director to develop our social media and marketing strategy, agree priorities and turn ideas into achievable campaigns.
- Create and manage a content calendar, balancing industry insights, recruitment expertise, opportunities and company culture.
- Research our audiences, competitors and relevant trends, suggesting new ways to reach and engage the right people.
- Social media and content creation
- Manage our company LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook accounts, tailoring content to each platform and audience.
- Create engaging posts, graphics, photographs and short videos that reflect April Quest s personality and expertise.
- Develop content around the industries we recruit within, including technology developments, hiring challenges, career advice and market insights.
- Turn the team s knowledge and experience into useful content, such as consultant interviews, practical advice and success stories.
- Monitor comments and messages, respond appropriately and direct enquiries to the relevant colleague.
- Capture photographs and videos at team socials, celebrations and company activities.
- Showcase what it s like to work at April Quest through employee stories, behind-the-scenes content and recruitment campaigns.
- Encourage colleagues to contribute ideas, appear in content and participate in social media activity.
- Help the team share relevant company content and strengthen their professional presence on LinkedIn.
- Support website content, blogs, email campaigns and marketing materials where relevant.
- Maintain a consistent tone of voice and visual style across our content.
- Track performance and share straightforward updates on what is working and what could improve.
- Assess success through relevant engagement, client and candidate enquiries, and interest in joining April Quest.
- Handle photographs, testimonials and client or candidate information with appropriate permission and care.

About You

You ll bring:
- Strong writing skills, attention to detail and an ability to adapt your message for different audiences.
- Familiarity with social media and networking platforms
- Creativity and an interest in photography, video and digital content.
- The confidence to suggest ideas, involve colleagues and get things moving.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage a varied workload.
- Curiosity about engineering, science, technology and the people working in these industries.
- A willingness to learn, test ideas and use feedback to improve.
- A degree in marketing, communications or a related subject would be welcome, but isn t essential. We re equally interested in relevant practical experience.
- Experience with tools such as Canva, video editing software or social media scheduling platforms would be useful. Previous recruitment industry experience is not required.

How To Apply

Please send your CV and a short introduction explaining why this role interests you. If you have examples of social media posts, videos, designs or marketing projects you ve created, we d love to see them.
